tfn.s: Fewer than 754 different students took part in the study.
tfn.why: Some students answered both surveys, so the 754 responses are "not 754 different students".

tfn.s: Under the new model, students could no longer start at 7:30.
tfn.why: Students "could arrive at 7:30 or wait until 8:30", so the early start stayed.

tfn.s: Most students gained extra sleep by going to bed earlier.
tfn.why: "Wake-up times shifted while bedtimes stayed roughly the same", so the extra sleep came in the morning.

tfn.s: The authors claim that the later start caused the higher maths and English scores.
tfn.why: They "conclude only that flexible schedules may offer an effective way to reduce adolescent sleep deficits".

tfn.s: Teachers at the school were happy to work in the early slot.

focus.note: Formal phrases like contingent on and tantamount to are common in reports. The preposition never changes.
